title: Mandelbulb
description: The canonical 3D fractal, ray-marched in real time. The polar power map z → zⁿ + c folds space into a bulbous, coral-like solid whose surface crawls with self-similar detail; a camera orbits it while an orbit trap tints the shell through an Inigo Quilez cosine palette and grazing rays build a soft coloured halo. Power (bulb order), fractal detail, orbit speed, camera distance, hue and glow are live params — raise the power to morph between smooth blobs and spiky urchins. Loudness nudges the orbit, beats flare the halo. Distance estimator after Daniel White / Paul Nylander.
